meta.name: baoyu-post-to-x
meta.description: 自媒体创作者需要在X(Twitter)发布内容时，支持图文、视频、引用推文及Markdown长文发布，通过真实Chrome浏览器绕过反自动化检测，一键完成多格式内容分发，有效规避封号风险。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键把图文视频和长文发布到X，规避封号风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常把图文视频同步到X，担心频繁操作被限流封号。
copy.tagline_en: Publish images, videos and long posts to X in one click, avoiding account bans.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly publish images, videos or long text to X and worry about being flagged or banned.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过真实 Chrome 浏览器把文字、图片、视频、引用推文和 Markdown 长文发布到 X。默认只做预览，加 --submit 参数才真正发出。
howto.when: 当你要求把内容发布到 X（Twitter）时接管，涵盖图文、视频、引用推文等形式的发布；长文发布需要 X Premium。

say.text: 把这段文字和这张图片发到 X，先给我看预览
say.note: 默认只预览，确认后加 --submit 发布

say.text: 引用这条推文并附上我的评论，先预览
say.note: 给出推文链接和评论文字即可

say.text: 用这份 Markdown 发一篇 X 长文，带上封面图
say.note: 长文发布需要 X Premium

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude posts text, images, videos, quote tweets, and Markdown long-form articles to X through a real Chrome browser. It previews by default; add --submit to actually publish.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask to publish something to X (Twitter), covering text-and-image posts, video posts, quote tweets, and long-form articles. Long-form publishing needs X Premium.

say_en.text: Post this text and this image to X, show me a preview first
say_en.note: Previews by default; add --submit to publish

say_en.text: Quote this tweet with my comment, preview it first
say_en.note: Give the tweet URL and comment text

say_en.text: Publish this Markdown as an X article with a cover image
